walkthrough.title: Using example 3. Each voice needs 1. A piece works if every voice OUTSIDE it appears at most 1 times; the piece can then be rewritten to fix the rest.

steps.text: Counts now: {'S': 3, 'A': 1, 'T': 0, 'B': 0}. Every voice above 1 has to shrink, so the piece must cover the extra singers.
Outside counts {'S': 1, 'A': 1, 'T': 0, 'B': 0} are all ≤ 1: piece length 2. Shortest 2.
